d: Trae Young put on a show against the Detroit Pistons, finishing with 37 points, 14 assists, and 4 three-pointers in a thrilling double-overtime battle. With this performance, Young recorded his 200th career game with at least 20 points and 10 assists, becoming just the 8th player in NBA history to reach the milestone. He accomplished the feat in only 511 career games, trailing only Oscar Robertson, who reached 200 such games in 355 appearances. Despite Trae’s historic night, the Pistons came away with a 144-140 victory, improving to 8-3 while the Wizards fell to 4-9.
